description: This Java class defines a response object for the 'ModifyAttribute' command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It encapsulates data related to modifying an attribute of a thing, including the thing's ID, the attribute's pointer, and its value. The class provides static factory methods for creating instances corresponding to different HTTP status codes, and methods to serialize/deserialize from JSON.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a 'ModifyAttribute' command, including the status, the thing ID, attribute pointer, and attribute value. Provides methods for creating instances based on event outcome and serializing/deserializing JSON.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a response indicating an attribute was created with status code 201 (Created).

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a response indicating an attribute was modified with status code 204 (No Content).

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ModifyAttributeResponse object from a JSON string or object.
